title: 5.2 The Mean Value Theorem

icans: I can use Rolle’s Theorem to find c with f′(c) = 0.
I can find the number c guaranteed by the Mean Value Theorem.
I can find where a function is increasing and decreasing.

vocab: if f is continuous on [a, b], _________________ on (a, b), and f(a) = f(b), then f′(c) = 0 for some c in (a, b)
if f is continuous on [a, b] and _________________ on (a, b), then f′(c) = (f(b) − f(a))/(b − a) for some c in (a, b)
f′ > 0 on an ___________ means f is increasing; f′ < 0 means f is decreasing
